decisions.title: Selected native client invoice issuance profile, numbering series, content and cancellation/reissue rules
decisions.ownerRole: Qualified accounting owner / client-authorized legal or tax reviewer
decisions.scope: ASCP Task13 official client invoice issuance, conditional on approved service profile; not firm fee invoices
decisions.consequence: Existing independently reviewed client invoice posting remains supported; CLIENT-SALES journal numbers are not official invoices. No numbering policy, tax treatment, issued bytes or delivery is invented. Resolve required profile and policy before claiming issue/delivery completion.

decisions.title: Approved independent release-checkpoint custody target and recovery contract
decisions.ownerRole: Deployment owner and designated custody/security/recovery owners
decisions.scope: ASCP Task28 authoritative checkpoint custody, separate from secondary SharePoint archive copy
requiredDecision: Exact authorized target and stable provider/custodian identity
Trust, retention/protection and read/restore access contract
Digest-addressed create-if-absent, conflicting-existing-byte refusal and unknown-write reconciliation
Approved bounded readback/verification and recovery evidence requirements
decisions.consequence: ADR-0009 keeps the release/archive store authoritative and SharePoint a secondary copy; it does not select an independent live checkpoint target. Existing hosts compose LocalAppendOnlyCheckpointStore; the unregistered Graph boundary deliberately refuses every operation. Keep local/synthetic operation; no new live provider, storage selection or permission inferred. Implement approved target only after its actual custody contract is available; technical verification and real recovery acceptance remain separate.

decisions.title: Qualified countdown semantics under ADR0018 DEC08
decisions.ownerRole: Firm methodology/compliance owner and deployment owner for implementation acceptance
decisions.scope: ASCP Task22/31 signature-anchored regulatory countdown; preserve issued evidence
decisions.consequence: ADR0018 DEC08 explicitly leaves countdown semantics open. Current SignReportAsync schedules from signed deliverable CreatedAt, then records SignatureApplication.SignedAt separately. Existing freeze test uses deliverable CreatedAt; this is not proof for a different approved anchor. Resolve the authoritative event/date/time and any transition rule without rewriting historical signatures/schedules or silently selecting a clock; preserve existing protection until approved semantics and focused evidence are available.
